purpose: Freeze the first bounded full-refresh worker-search admission after parser, scalar, adapter, transactional routing and local referee qualification passed.
required_observations: route_commit status=ok ruleset=crazyhouse with exact profile and legacy digest identity
readyok after the exact route commits
at least one depth-1 search information line
one non-sentinel legal root bestmove per run
byte-stable engine and legacy network before and after all runs
zero engine stderr and normal process exit
fail_closed: a route, profile, backend, identity or position-epoch mismatch must not search
a missing, corrupt, incompatible or stale legacy backend must not search
the worker must abort rather than use official NNUE, classical evaluation or a stale legacy backend when Crazyhouse evaluation fails
stopping_rule: Any fixture, load, route, search, drop, determinism, stderr, exit, artifact-identity or standard-control mismatch rejects the implementation. No result-dependent fixture changes are allowed after the red observation.
